text:
olivia: Heads-up — want to get buy-in on Permissions UI v2. Proposal: move from a rigid role matrix to roles + scopes (roles = semantic bundles, scopes = fine-grained resource actions). Goals: simpler enterprise mappings, per-route quotas, clearer audit trails. Quick feedback?

mike: Does this require a new backend surface? Our current /v1/roles is flat. We'll need scopes CRUD + enforcement hooks. How do we migrate custom roles?

raj: +1 for scopes. We should design for RBAC + attributes (RBAC core, ABAC opt-in later). Important: SSO group -> role mapping, and generate audit events for permission changes (permission.change).

mike: Rough API sketch: 
```
POST /api/v2/roles
{
  "name":"Viewer",
  "scopes":["models.list","jobs.read"]
}
```
We also need an endpoint to preview effective permissions for a user/org.

maria: UX note — don't overwhelm admins. Provide a small set of presets (Viewer, Developer, Admin) + a scoped policy wizard. Preview pane should show allowed actions per console page (e.g., "Can delete model?" true/false).

theo: Enforcement question: do we enforce at the edge gateway or in each service? My opinion: primary enforcement at edge for latency + cost, with service-side fallback for defense-in-depth. Also need TTL for role->scope cache so group changes propagate quickly but avoid stampeding.

mike: For migration: convert legacy role matrix into a default mapping script; surface any custom roles as-is and tag with "needs-review". Write integration tests that exercise enforcement at gateway and service fallback.

chris: From enterprise customers: they want per-team admin roles, ability to restrict model download/export, and SAML group sync. Also long retention for audit logs. :thumbsup:

olivia: Telemetry fields we should capture on every change: permission_granted_by, changed_by, change_reason, before_scopes, after_scopes, request_id. Need a retention toggle for enterprise: 1y / 7y / custom.

raj: Compliance asks: exportable audit CSVs and HMAC-signed audit bundles for legal requests. Also we should include the req-id in every permission check log so we can trace to an API call.

infra-bot: deploy-bot: Scheduled deploy for branch feature/rbac-v2 to staging on 2026-03-25 02:00 UTC (window 1h).

maria: I'll produce three quick mocks: 1) role list + presets, 2) scoped wizard, 3) preview panel. Will drop Figma link here by EOD Thursday.

olivia: Action items: mike + raj — API contract + migration plan; theo — enforcement design + cache TTL proposal; maria — mocks; chris — capture enterprise edge cases for SAML & exports. Sync Friday 10:00am. Thanks! :calendar:
